Director of Cloud Engineering at Cloudflare
Location: Seattle, WA / Remote

Overview:
We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager / Director to lead our Cloud Platform Engineering teams.
You will manage engineering managers and staff engineers, define quarterly roadmaps, and foster an inclusive culture of technical excellence.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of direct people management experience in cloud infrastructure
- Experience leading teams building high-availability distributed systems on AWS or GCP
- Proven track record of hiring, mentoring, and retaining top engineering talent
